args.description: lifts the invisible opponent he is holding high with his free hand and lets go, then swings a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged upward over his head, then returns to the ready stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame. The whole weapon stays inside the picture. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no glow, no flash, no sparks, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground; the whole body, the weapon and any trail stay inside the picture.
